The DLX relocation type number space is non-contiguous (basic types 0-6, extended types at 0x10000+), but the default case in the switch statement allows arbitrary index values to reach the array access. condicion_fuente: Multiple Use-After-Free vulnerabilities were found in the add_archive_element function in ld/ldmain.c of the GNU linker (ld), a component of binutils. The root cause is that plugin_maybe_claim() in ld/plugin.c frees the original BFD object via bfd_close/_bfd_delete_bfd when entry->the_bfd->my_archive == NULL, but the caller retains both the original abfd parameter and a shallow copy (orig_input.the_bfd) as dangling pointers. These dangling pointers are subsequently dereferenced at three distinct locations in add_archive_element: 1. Line ~1442: accessing abfd->my_archive via bfd_usrdata(abfd->my_archive) 2. Line ~1493: multiple accesses to abfd and abfd->my_archive in a conditional check and bfd_get_filename

condicion_fuente: A flaw was found in the util-linux chfn and chsh utilities when compiled with Readline support. The Readline library uses an "INPUTRC" environment variable to get a path to the library config file. revision: Registro TEMP sobre acceso local/arranque sin contraseña root. El contenedor no usa init como entrypoint; arranque físico del host no auditado. No se descarta por considerarlo de baja severidad.

condicion_fuente: Tar 1.15.1 does not properly warn the user when extracting setuid or setgid files, which may allow local users or remote attackers to gain privileges.
revision: Tar participa en restauración QA, con archivos locales previstos; eso no acredita seguridad ante archivos maliciosos. No se aplica parche ni se habilita importación de archivos de visitantes.

condicion_fuente: tar's rmt command may have undesired side effects
revision: Registro Debian sobre rmt: proyecto utiliza tar local y no configura transporte de cinta remota. Alcance nativo de tar y archivos maliciosos sigue pendiente.
